description:
🍗🔥 𝐅𝐎𝐎𝐃𝐈𝐄'𝐒 𝐅𝐑𝐈𝐃𝐀𝐘 is back!

If you 𝐜𝐚𝐧'𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐥𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐭... this might not be for you. 🌶️😂

This week, we stopped by 𝐓𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝟐𝟐 in Round Rock, and if you're craving 𝐍𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐯𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞-𝐬𝐭𝐲𝐥𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐭 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧, this place absolutely delivers.

🔥 𝟔 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐬
🍗 Crispy on the outside. Juicy on the inside.
🧀 Creamy, rich mac & cheese.
🥧 The housemade pie alone is worth the drive.

I ordered one of the hotter levels... and let's just say my mouth was on 🔥😂 𝐍𝐎 𝐑𝐄𝐆𝐑𝐄𝐓𝐒.

If you're anywhere near 𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐑𝐨𝐜𝐤 or 𝐀𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧, this spot belongs on your foodie list.

👇 What's the hottest chicken you think you could handle?

📌 𝐒𝐚𝐯𝐞 this post for your next food adventure and send it to your friend who thinks they can handle spicy food! 🌶️🔥
